readings: For each patient, calculate HGB/HCT on every laboratory record where both values are present and HCT is nonzero, then average those record-level ratios to get the patient's ratio. Average those patient ratios, giving each patient equal weight. Select patients whose ratio exceeds that cross-patient average. Return one row containing the mean of the selected patients' average nonmissing PIC values, the mean of their ratios, and the mean of their ratios minus the cross-patient average. Ignore missing values in each mean.

For each patient, separately average their nonmissing HGB values and their nonmissing HCT values across laboratory records, then divide the average HGB by the average HCT to get the patient's ratio, provided both averages exist and average HCT is nonzero. Average those patient ratios, giving each patient equal weight. Select patients whose ratio exceeds that cross-patient average. Return one row containing the mean of the selected patients' average nonmissing PIC values, the mean of their ratios, and the mean of their ratios minus the cross-patient average. Ignore missing values in each mean.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
                 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS ratio FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic),
    AVG(p.ratio),
    AVG(p.ratio - c.ratio)
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average AS c
WHERE p.ratio > c.ratio

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic),
    AVG(p.ratio),
    AVG(p.ratio - c.mean_ratio)
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average AS c
WHERE p.ratio > c.mean_ratio
